mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals increased consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy in a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% year-over-year and industrial production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
